reviews.text: Absolutely love this phone! The camera quality is stunning, especially in low light conditions.
Battery barely lasts half a day with normal usage. Very disappointing for the price.
The display is gorgeous — vibrant colors and great viewing angles.
Phone overheats constantly when playing games or using GPS navigation.
Fast and responsive. Apps open instantly and multitasking is smooth.
The box arrived completely crushed. Luckily the phone was fine but very concerning.
Screen scratches way too easily even with careful use. Needs a screen protector out of the box.
Best smartphone I've ever owned. Worth every penny.
Charging cable was missing from the box. Had to buy one separately.
The facial recognition is incredibly fast and accurate. Unlocks in a split second.
Sound quality from the speakers is tinny and weak. Can barely hear it in a noisy room.
Delivery was delayed by over two weeks with no updates from the carrier.
Sleek design and lightweight. Fits perfectly in my hand.
The phone randomly restarts at least once a day. Extremely frustrating.
Great value for money. Competes with flagships at half the price.
Package was clearly opened before delivery. Seal was broken and accessories were loose.
Night mode on the camera is phenomenal. My photos look professional.
Wi-Fi keeps disconnecting every few minutes. Had to factory reset twice.
The fingerprint sensor works flawlessly every single time.
Received a different color than what I ordered. Customer service was unhelpful.
Battery life is amazing. Easily lasts two full days with moderate use.
The phone gets extremely hot while charging. I'm worried about safety.
Smooth software experience. No bloatware and regular security updates.
Earbuds that were supposed to come with it were missing. No packing slip either.
Camera zoom is impressive even at 10x. Way better than my old phone.
Screen started showing dead pixels after just two weeks of use.
Lightweight and comfortable to hold for extended periods. Love the matte finish.
Delivery packaging was just a thin envelope. No bubble wrap, no protection whatsoever.
Fast charging works great. 0 to 100 in about 45 minutes.
Microphone quality is terrible on calls. People always complain they can't hear me.
Excellent build quality. Feels premium and durable.
The phone case I ordered with it arrived but the phone itself was damaged.
Video recording in 4K is buttery smooth. Great for content creators.
GPS accuracy is way off. Navigation keeps losing my location.
The AMOLED display is beautiful. Deep blacks and vivid colors.
Arrived a week late and the shipping box was soaking wet from rain damage.
5G connectivity is blazing fast in supported areas.
Battery drains like crazy in standby mode. Loses 30% overnight doing nothing.
Setup was easy and data transfer from my old phone was seamless.
The protective film on the screen was already peeled off. Seems like a returned item.
Haptic feedback is top-notch. Every tap feels satisfying.
Phone freezes constantly when switching between apps. Very laggy.
Love the stereo speakers. Great for watching movies without headphones.
Missing the SIM ejector tool from the box. Minor but annoying.
Portrait mode creates beautiful bokeh effects. My friends think I have a DSLR.
Bluetooth connectivity is unstable. Keeps dropping connection with my earbuds.
The matte black color looks absolutely stunning in person.
Product box was taped shut with generic tape instead of factory seal. Suspicious.
Wireless charging works perfectly with my existing Qi pad.
Touch screen becomes unresponsive in cold weather. Really annoying in winter.
Software updates come regularly and always improve performance.
The phone arrived with a cracked screen. Packaging had zero padding inside.
Dual SIM support is a game changer for managing work and personal numbers.
Volume buttons feel cheap and wobbly. Don't feel like they'll last.
Incredible battery optimization. Adaptive battery really works.
Ordered express shipping but it came via standard delivery. No refund offered.
The ultra-wide camera lens captures amazing landscape shots.
Phone heats up so much during video calls that it becomes uncomfortable to hold.
Clean and intuitive user interface. Everything just works.
The charger brick in the box doesn't work. Dead on arrival.
Face unlock works even in the dark. Infrared sensor is fantastic.
Signal reception is poor compared to my previous phone. Dropped calls frequently.
Premium feeling materials all around. Glass back and aluminum frame feel luxurious.
Received someone else's order mixed in with mine. Logistics are a mess.
The always-on display is great for checking time and notifications at a glance.
Camera app crashes frequently. Lost several important photos because of this.
Water resistance actually works! Accidentally dropped it in the pool and it survived.
Shipping label showed wrong address but somehow it arrived. Very careless handling.
Edge-to-edge display is immersive for watching videos and gaming.
The phone randomly vibrates with no notification. Ghost vibrations are creepy.
Expandable storage with microSD is a huge plus. 256GB and counting.
Box was completely open when delivered. No seal, accessories scattered everywhere.
Macro photography mode captures incredible detail. Amazing for close-up shots.
Power button got stuck after just one month. Had to use software restart.
The under-display fingerprint sensor is fast and reliable.
Delivered to wrong address first. Had to wait for redelivery which took another week.
This phone handles multitasking like a beast. 12GB RAM makes a real difference.
Screen has a noticeable yellow tint that no setting can fix. Defective panel.
Super fast and responsive UI. Zero lag even with 20 apps open.
The quick start guide was missing from the box. Not a big deal but still.
AI photo enhancement makes every picture look polished. Love this feature.
Battery swells after 3 months of use. This is a serious safety hazard.
Smooth scrolling and 120Hz refresh rate make everything look fluid.
Outer shipping box had no fragile label. Found the product box dented badly.
The gesture navigation system is intuitive and easy to learn.
Constant software bugs after the latest update. Should have been tested more.
Excellent call quality. Both parties hear each other crystal clear.
The warranty card was missing. Now I can't register for manufacturer warranty.
Super sharp display at 1440p resolution. Text and images are crisp.
Phone shuts down at 20% battery remaining. The battery indicator is unreliable.
NFC payment works flawlessly. Tap to pay is so convenient.
Ordered two phones, only received one. Had to fight customer service for a refund.
The camera AI scene recognition is incredibly smart. Auto-adjusts settings perfectly.
Speaker grille collects dust easily and is impossible to clean properly.
Love the customizable themes and icon packs. Made it truly my own.
Product was clearly used and repackaged as new. Had fingerprints all over it.
120Hz display is amazing for gaming. Everything feels so responsive.
Proximity sensor malfunctions during calls. Screen stays on against my face and I accidentally press buttons.
Wireless Android Auto works perfectly with my car. Seamless integration.
The phone was shipped without any protective wrapping inside the box. Just rattling around loose.
